review_notes: I read the whole file. I also read fixedKernelCoefficient in KernelGeometry.lean and the uses of actualKernelCoefficient in TerminalThreshold, TailAbsorption, SourceScaleCaps, RetainedWidth and UniformMeasure. The file has no simp attributes. The only simp-interface problem I found is the missing normal-form lemma for actualKernelCoefficient, which three downstream files re-derive by hand. I did not recommend @[simp] on the theorems actual_theta_kernel_argument and actualKernelSourceTerm_numeric. The second is already used through simpa only, and the first has a large LHS and would be a poor simp rule. I could not run Lean, so I did not check that the proposed lemma would compile or that the downstream proofs would shorten as described.

findings.problem: actualKernelCoefficient is a plain def with no normalising unfolding lemma next to it. Its value is X/(27*tau^2*(N(span c)*N(∏ ideal))^2)*r^3 once absNorm of 1 and of a product is simplified. Each consumer therefore unfolds two definitions and re-runs the same absNorm cleanup, with ad hoc simp sets. TerminalThreshold does `simp only [actualKernelCoefficient,fixedKernelCoefficient,map_one,Nat.cast_one,one_pow,mul_one,map_mul,Nat.cast_mul]` to prove a local `hcc`. TailAbsorption and SourceScaleCaps use `unfold familyRawScale actualKernelCoefficient fixedKernelCoefficient` followed by a `simp only [...,map_mul,map_one,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_one,one_pow,mul_one]`. RetainedWidth also unfolds both definitions. Because the def is not marked @[simp], `simp` leaves actualKernelCoefficient folded. The one place that needs the closed form had to state it as a private `have`.
findings.proposed_change: Next to the def, add a lemma `actualKernelCoefficient_eq` stating `actualKernelCoefficient F s m X = X/(27*(sourceCuspScale s.index)^2*((Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span {c}):ℝ)*(Ideal.absNorm (∏ i, F.ideal i):ℝ))^2)*(ramifiedScale 1 completedRamifiedStep m)^3`. Prove it once by `simp only [actualKernelCoefficient, fixedKernelCoefficient, map_mul, map_one, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_one, one_pow, mul_one]`, which is the script TerminalThreshold already uses for `hcc`. Then replace the repeated unfold-and-simp blocks with `rw [actualKernelCoefficient_eq]`, or `simp only [actualKernelCoefficient_eq]`. Keep the definition itself unfolded only on request, i.e. do not make it @[simp], so that kernelCenter (actualKernelCoefficient ..) terms stay compact elsewhere.
findings.benefit: The normal form of the coefficient is fixed once and the absNorm-of-1 and absNorm-of-product cleanup is not repeated. Downstream proofs no longer depend on the exact internal shape of fixedKernelCoefficient. They also stop using inconsistent ad hoc simp sets, so a change to the definition would need one proof update instead of several.
